title: Curve Points can't be reordered in the inspector
body: ### Tested versions Godot v4.7.stable - doesn't work at all Godot v4.6.3 - doesn't work as expected Godot 4.4.1.stable - doesn't work as expected ### System information Godot v4.7.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.31021.1015) - AMD Ryzen 7 5800X 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 127.9 GiB memory ### Issue description When editing a curve, there are these buttons / hamburger icons which I would assume are used to swap the order of points. In 4.7, these buttons don't do anything at all, despite the console outputting a message. _Above screenshots are from 4.7.stable_ Testing in previous versions, these buttons did do something, but they didn't really work as expected nor did they work consistently. In 4.6.3 stable... I would expect that clicking this would switch the Y values of points 2 and 3. But that's not what happens. it seems to copy the Y value to the other position. Perhaps that is the intended behavior, but the UI is unclear, and there is no hover tooltip to explain what is actually supposed to happen here. Using the hamburger-drag icon has a similar result, sometimes it copies the Y value, sometimes it doesn't do anything. But it isn't for reordering points as you would expect it would So I think this is a 2-part issue. First, it doesn't work at all in 4.7, and second, the original behavior was unclear so it should be documented with a hover tooltip to explain what the arrows and hamburger drag icon do. If you right click, you can see an option to move up, move down, but similarly, clicking this has an inconsistent result. Sometimes it copies the Y value into the position above, sometimes it does nothing, but it doesn't seem to ever actually _swap_ the values. ### Steps to reproduce 1. Create a new project. 2. Add a Node2D and a script with an exported Curve variable. 3. Create the curve and add a couple of points. 4. Click the arrows in the Points property, nothing happens. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) N/A
